# Blue Harbor Analytics -- Master Service Agreement

This Master Service Agreement records the terms on which Blue Harbor Analytics provides analytics tooling and reporting services to Halvard Systems. It is synthetic material generated for NorthForge evaluation; Blue Harbor Analytics, Halvard Systems, and every person named below are fictional.

## Term and Renewal

The term of this Master Service Agreement runs from 2025-01-21 to 2027-01-21 with no automatic renewal. Blue Harbor Analytics shall tell Halvard Systems at least thirty (30) days before expiry whether it intends to propose renewal terms.

## Termination

Either party may terminate this Master Service Agreement for cause if the other materially breaches it and does not cure the breach within thirty (30) days of written notice. Halvard Systems may also terminate for convenience, in whole or in part, on thirty (30) days written notice to Blue Harbor Analytics.

## Limitation of Liability

Liability is capped. The aggregate liability of Halvard Systems and of Blue Harbor Analytics for all claims under this Master Service Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the three (3) months preceding the claim. This cap does not apply to breaches of confidentiality, to data protection breaches, or to unpaid fees, for which liability remains uncapped.

## Governing Law

This Master Service Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, excluding its conflict-of-laws rules. Halvard Systems and Blue Harbor Analytics submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the State of New York.

## Data Protection

Blue Harbor Analytics handles Customer Data under this Master Service Agreement without a separate Data Protection Addendum. Blue Harbor Analytics shall tell Halvard Systems about a confirmed personal data breach without undue delay, but no subprocessor approval right is granted.

## Payment Terms

Blue Harbor Analytics invoices Halvard Systems monthly in arrears. Undisputed invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt, and late undisputed amounts accrue interest at one and a half percent (1.5%) per month.

## Confidentiality

Confidential Information disclosed under this Master Service Agreement remains the property of the disclosing party. Blue Harbor Analytics shall return or destroy the Confidential Information of Halvard Systems on request, and confidentiality obligations survive three (3) years beyond termination.

## Notices

Notices under this Master Service Agreement are effective when sent to contracts@halvard.example.com for Halvard Systems and to contracts@blueharbor.example.com for Blue Harbor Analytics, with delivery confirmed in writing. Either party may change its notice address by giving notice in the same way.

## Signatures

Executed by Tobias Renner (Head of Vendor Management) for Halvard Systems and by Rosa Alven (General Manager) for Blue Harbor Analytics. The signatories are fictional characters created for this synthetic corpus.
